integrity: A complete self-contained proof is given. Finite stand-alone tests supplement rather than replace the proof; no independent mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact minimum common-supersequence length and sharp square-root leading constant are not determined. The theorem applies only to the complete family of binary length-k words with exactly two ones, k>=3. The literature comparison cannot rule out all unindexed equivalents.
title: Square-root excess for common supersequences of all binary two-marker words
